name: Ashley Romanias
current_role: Director, Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs
summary: Ashley Romanias took over the Labor Department’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs when Catherine Eschbach left for the EEOC. She had been a senior policy adviser at the department working across EBSA, OSHA and MSHA. The administration has proposed eliminating the office’s separate funding.
